title: lathyrus tenuior
intro: Lathyrus tenuior, commonly known as the slender peashrub, is a perennial legume native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus tenuior include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties.
